about: Cross-question answers: replies that answer other questions than the one asked. Synthetic people only. Split dev/held-out (stratified by category) before any result was looked at; tune on dev only. Scored by tests/cross_answer_eval.py. Units: cm, kg, minutes. expect: values that must be recorded (a list means any of them); allow: may be recorded; must_not: fields that must not be recorded; unknown: fields recorded as "I don't know"; skip: answered early, so never asked; next: the question open at the end (null: not checked); confirm: a read-back is expected; conflict: a confirmed answer contradicted, which must be surfaced and never silently overwritten.
